name: flint-steel-tnt-portal
comment: WP-2.6. ItemFlintAndSteel.onItemUse (use_item): fire in front of the clicked face when that cell is air (the ignite sound draws Item.itemRand), one point of wear either way. Stone platform y 60; the player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, -8.5) with a flint and steel in hotbar 0 and a worn one (damage 63 of 64) in hotbar 1. t 2: fire on the platform; t 3: on the floor beside a block (side 4); t 4: the cell in front is stone (no fire, still worn); t 5: under a floating block (side 0): BlockFire.onBlockAdded removes fire with no support and nothing flammable; t 6: on the bottom obsidian of an empty frame: BlockFire.onBlockAdded lights the portal (BlockPortal.tryToCreatePortal); t 7: fire beside a TNT block, which the fire's random ticks may prime. t 10: the dig op with the flint and steel held on another TNT: BlockTNT.onBlockClicked sets metadata 1 and the instant break (hardness 0) primes it (EntityTNTPrimed, Math.random kick) instead of dropping it; Item.onBlockDestroyed is Item's (no wear). t 12: hotbar 1; t 13-14: two uses wear the second one past its maximum: ItemStack.damageItem drops the stack to 0 and use_item clears the slot. The fires burn out on stone.
